issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וַתַּעֲלִי' (and you went up) is rendered as 'cởi bỏ áo mình' (you took off your clothes), which is an addition/mistranslation not present in the Hebrew. The Hebrew verb means 'to go up/ascend', not 'to undress'.

The Hebrew 'יָד חָזִית' (you have seen a hand) is rendered as 'nhìn chăm chăm vào hình ảnh của chúng' (you stared at their images), adding 'hình ảnh của chúng' (their images) which is not in the Hebrew; the Hebrew simply says 'you have seen a hand' (likely referring to an idolatrous symbol).
